Class LuaScriptRuntimeService

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.lua.LuaScriptRuntimeService
public final class LuaScriptRuntimeService extends Object
Manages the lifecycle of MeshApp Lua scripts.

Creates execution sandboxes, binds scripts to the active application connection, starts normal and debug sessions, stops active sessions, and exposes runtime state to the MeshApp IDE UI.

    • autostartScriptsForNode

      public void autostartScriptsForNode(String nodeId, Consumer<LuaScriptEvent> sink)
      Starts all radio Lua scripts with autorun enabled for the specified node.

      Called after the connection's protocol runtime is ready, so scripts receive populated node state and the correct transport target.

      Parameters:
      nodeId - local node id of the active connection
      sink - launch-event sink; may be null
